# Phaseo

> Phaseo is an open-source AI gateway and model intelligence database for comparing AI models, providers, pricing, benchmarks, latency, throughput, and gateway support.

Every page on phaseo.app is also available as Markdown. Add `.md` to the page URL (for example https://phaseo.app/models/openai/gpt-5.5.md, or https://phaseo.app/index.md for the homepage), or request the page with `Accept: text/markdown`.

## Core product pages

- [Models](https://phaseo.app/models): Browse AI models by provider, capability, modality, pricing, and gateway status.
- [API Providers](https://phaseo.app/api-providers): Compare providers by model coverage, modality support, and usage signals.
- [Rankings](https://phaseo.app/rankings): Usage, latency, throughput, and cost rankings across tracked models.
- [Pricing](https://phaseo.app/pricing): Gateway pricing, credit fees, and cost guidance.
- [Docs](https://phaseo.app/docs/v1): Developer documentation for the gateway and API.
- [Docs LLM index](https://phaseo.app/llms.txt): Documentation index for AI tools and answer engines.
- [OpenRouter alternative and migration guide](https://phaseo.app/migrate/openrouter): Move an OpenRouter integration to Phaseo with endpoint, API key, model mapping, streaming, validation, and rollback instructions.
- [Phaseo vs OpenRouter](https://phaseo.app/compare/openrouter): Compare gateway routing, pricing, BYOK, model intelligence, and observability.
